scope: Analysis I only: twenty lessons and overview review in EN/DE/ES

findings.assessment: All three locales now explicitly restrict OR-of-failures to negating a conjunctive conclusion. The disjunctive countermodel no longer contradicts the text.
Both Spanish task and answer now say no tienen por qué. Identical solution sets need not contain all reals; equivalence does not prohibit identities true everywhere. The zero example remains.
EN no need, DE nicht nötig and ES no hace falta restore optionality. The separate exercise instruction to leave the interior unchanged remains task-specific, not a general mathematical prohibition.
DE and ES now separate the reals containing both classes from the irrational-only failure of integer-quotient representation; the sqrt(2) example and set difference remain.
Whole-number restriction restored in all three integer definitions; zero convention and negative example retained.

All three locales explain contained but not equal before the proof obligation. Both every-element inclusion and a larger-set element absent from the smaller set are explicit; all four strictness witnesses remain.

Spanish known-truth/known-falsity questions are complete clauses; German endpoint argument names first, second and third conditions and both directions; Spanish table explanation explicitly names the conjunction and retains both reasons for failed implication/equivalence.

All five named terminology targets repaired: Spanish evenness is ser par/is par, German equivalent-in-domain phrase is ordinary wording, Integer and Integerproben replaced by ganze Zahl and Zahlenproben.
All three named agreement/imperative targets repaired to número real arbitrario, supón and un x real fijo; independent-direction reasoning and arbitrary-real scope unchanged.
All three questions now state exactly two tokens IN TOTAL, both nonblue. Only A excludes every candidate; B explicitly retains unchecked contents. The existing answer follows again.
Condition/Bedingung/condición explicitly defines the predicate; meaningfulness for each allowed object and fixed other parameters remain in the same paragraph.
Can/kann/puede restores sufficiency, not necessity, of a complete finite permission table. The infinite-domain sampling limitation and shared-implies-separate argument remain.

All three repaired answers explicitly assert a fixed person who cannot read a book on each shelf, with the book on that shelf and permitted to depend on it. No intrinsic-illegibility or ownership claim remains in the repaired sentence. German class membership reads in the established class context.

The targeted German and Spanish closure/positive-one explanation and corresponding answer are now grammatical complete sentences: real addition preserves membership and adding positive one makes the result greater than the input. Targeted five/six wording, blue-token existence, odd-card existence and empty-universal wording preserve their meanings. Other terse recap phrasing remains, but the repaired passages no longer require reconstructing a missing comparison.

Each locale now restricts the domain OF a true universal statement, including the empty set. Enlargement may introduce failure; restricting a false claim does not prove the original. No truth property is assigned to a domain.
Each hint unambiguously negates the whole conjunction. The adjacent answer retains inclusive OR and the red-unnumbered separating example, not two simultaneous failures.
The Spanish deferred prompt explicitly reconstructs all four complements and all four conditional rows before deriving the NEGATION of convergence.

All nine deferred production/mutation instructions are restored: change the collection from two successes to none; write a new four-sentence proof and label its sentence roles; construct and justify zero/one/multiple-success examples. The fourth zero/one/two comparison prompt and practice wrappers remain.

Receipt-only P3 advice is recorded as y=3 VERSUS y=2, not the fraction 3/2. The actual lesson displays forall x in {1,2}: x<y; y=3 makes it true, y=2 makes it false at x=2. An assigned free value enables evaluation without syntactically binding y. Corrected objective ordinal 8 is included in this report for all locales; original receipt and shared integration map are intentionally untouched.

assessment.reviewed_wording: Choice dependence permits tolerance and fixed context, not later $n$. Proof dependence concerns the estimate’s justification. Correct choice order cannot repair false arithmetic, and correct arithmetic cannot repair a witness chosen after the test index. Constant $N$ may ignore tolerance.

Wahlabhängigkeit erlaubt Toleranz und festen Kontext, nicht späteres $n$. Beweisabhängigkeit betrifft die Schätzungsbegründung. Die richtige Wahlreihenfolge behebt keine falsche Rechnung, und eine richtige Rechnung behebt keine Zeugenwahl nach dem Prüfindex. Konstantes $N$ darf die Toleranz ignorieren.

La dependencia de elección permite tolerancia y contexto fijo, no el $n$ posterior. La de justificación concierne a la estimación. El orden correcto de elección no corrige cuentas falsas, y las cuentas correctas no corrigen la elección de un testigo después del índice de prueba. Un $N$ constante puede ignorar la tolerancia.
Later, reconstruct the full proof, identifying where the existence of a natural threshold and positive reciprocal order enter; logical negation does not require this proof.
Rekonstruiere später den vollständigen Beweis und benenne, wo die Existenz eines natürlichen Startindex und die positive Kehrwertordnung eingehen; logische Negation benötigt diesen Beweis nicht.
Reconstruye después la prueba completa e indica dónde intervienen la existencia de un umbral natural y el orden de recíprocos positivos; la negación lógica no requiere esta prueba.

A real sequence assigns one real term to every positive natural index. Zero is excluded here; specify other conventions. Here $n$ is the index, $a_n$ is the term at that index, and $a$ is the whole function. Subscripts do not multiply; the arrow specifies domains, not convergence.

A tail includes $N$ and all later indices: from $N=3$ the device gives only threes. Both $N$ and $n$ are natural numbers: $N$ starts the tail, and $n$ is the index being tested. Zero then always one agrees with constant one from two onward, but is unequal to it.

$x-y$ is displacement from $y$ to $x$; absolute value gives length. Reversing subtraction negates displacement. A number and its opposite have equal absolute values. For a positive input, both absolute values equal that input; for a negative input, both equal its positive opposite; at zero, both equal zero. Hence $d(x,y)=d(y,x)$ universally.

Eine reelle Folge ordnet jedem positiven natürlichen Index genau ein reelles Glied zu. Null ist hier ausgeschlossen; andere Konventionen sind anzugeben. Dabei ist $n$ der Index, $a_n$ das Glied an diesem Index und $a$ die ganze Funktion. Indizes multiplizieren nicht; der Pfeil nennt Bereiche, nicht Konvergenz.

Ein Endstück enthält das Glied am Index $N$ und alle späteren Glieder: Beim Gerät sind ab $N=3$ alle Glieder drei. Beide Indizes sind natürliche Zahlen: $N$ beginnt das Endstück, und $n$ ist der zu prüfende Index. Die Folge mit null am Anfang und danach immer eins stimmt ab Index zwei mit der konstanten Einsfolge überein; die beiden Folgen sind aber nicht gleich.

$x-y$ ist Verschiebung von $y$ zu $x$; ihr Betrag gibt die Länge. Umgekehrte Subtraktion negiert sie. Eine Zahl und ihre Gegenzahl haben gleiche Beträge. Bei positiver Eingabe sind beide Beträge gleich dem Eingabewert; bei negativer Eingabe sind beide gleich seiner positiven Gegenzahl; bei null sind beide null. Somit gilt $d(x,y)=d(y,x)$ allgemein.

Una sucesión real asigna un término real a cada índice natural positivo. Aquí cero queda excluido; indica otras convenciones. Aquí $n$ es el índice, $a_n$ es el término en ese índice y $a$ es la función completa. Los subíndices no multiplican; la flecha indica dominios, no convergencia.

Una cola incluye el término de índice $N$ y todos los posteriores: desde $N=3$, el aparato solo da treses. Tanto $N$ como $n$ son naturales: $N$ inicia la cola y $n$ es el índice que se comprueba. La sucesión que empieza con cero y sigue siempre con uno coincide desde el índice dos con la sucesión constante uno, pero las dos sucesiones no son iguales.

$x-y$ es desplazamiento de $y$ a $x$; su valor absoluto da longitud. Invertir la resta lo niega. Un número y su opuesto tienen el mismo valor absoluto. Si la entrada es positiva, ambos valores absolutos son iguales a ella; si es negativa, ambos son iguales a su opuesto positivo; si es cero, ambos son cero. Así, $d(x,y)=d(y,x)$ universalmente.
Later, construct two different continuations of one three-term prefix: why do observations not define a sequence?
Konstruiere später zwei verschiedene Fortsetzungen desselben Drei-Glieder-Anfangs: Warum definieren Beobachtungen keine Folge?
Construye después dos continuaciones distintas del mismo prefijo de tres términos: ¿por qué observar no define una sucesión?

Optional, not required for [logical negation](../negating-sequence-convergence/#from-negating-sequence-convergence). Accept without proof: **Archimedean unboundedness**, every real bound is exceeded by some positive natural number; **positive reciprocal order**, increasing a positive denominator decreases or preserves its reciprocal. Quantifier notation proves neither fact.

Optional, nicht nötig für [logische Negation](../negating-sequence-convergence/#from-negating-sequence-convergence). Akzeptiere ohne Beweis: **Archimedische Unbeschränktheit**, zu jeder reellen Schranke gibt es eine größere positive natürliche Zahl; **positive Kehrwertordnung**, größere positive Nenner liefern kleinere oder gleiche Kehrwerte. Quantorenschreibweise beweist beides nicht.

Opcional, no necesaria para [negación lógica](../negating-sequence-convergence/#from-negating-sequence-convergence). Acepta sin prueba: **propiedad arquimediana**, toda cota real es superada por algún natural positivo; **orden de recíprocos positivos**, aumentar un denominador positivo disminuye o mantiene su recíproco. La notación de cuantificadores no demuestra estos hechos.
